question: Do sites recommended using only 30 m data cover more of the targets' metre-scale slope conditions than a simple slope-only method? Coarse-screening benefit only.
window: 1.92 km square for both 30 m (recommendation) and 2 m (scoring); same physical extent, centred on the same point.

candidate_sites.windows: the 64 Gate 2 candidate centres (results/candidates.json), each a 1.92 km window
candidate_sites.grouping_rule: Windows whose centres are < 5 km apart OR whose 1.92 km windows overlap belong to one site (transitive closure, union-find). A site is one budget unit. Site ID = sorted first window name.
candidate_sites.site_30m_distance_A: distance from a site to a target = minimum over the site's windows
candidate_sites.site_bins: for B (30 m) and scoring (2 m) a multi-window site's bin fractions use the pooled valid area of all its windows
candidate_sites.eligibility: a window is eligible only if >= 95% valid at both 30 m (COP30) and 2 m (3DEP); a site is eligible if >= 1 of its windows is; ineligible windows are dropped from their site

targets.design: 8 geographic groups x 3 non-overlapping 1.92 km targets = 24
targets.group_centre_candidates: 16 points evenly spaced (27.5 km) along a square ring 15 km outside the Gate 2 80 km box (box per results/candidates.json area_utm11n), in UTM 11N, ordered clockwise starting at the NW corner
targets.target_layout: 3 windows per group: group centre, and +/-2.5 km east (non-overlapping; 0.58 km gaps)
targets.acceptance_order: walk the 16 ring points in order; accept a group if: (a) all 3 targets >= 95% valid at 2 m (3DEP 1 m, any project) and at 30 m (COP30); (b) every target window >= 5 km edge-to-edge from every candidate window; (c) group centre >= 20 km from every already accepted group centre; (d) every target window >= 5 km from every patch used in earlier gates (Gate 1/2/2b/V1 incl. Dumont, Avawatz, Kelso, Mesquite, Eureka, Mojave box). Stop at 8 groups.
targets.if_fewer_than_8: data-insufficient -> INCONCLUSIVE. No relaxation of distances or quality.

data.recommendation_30m: Copernicus GLO-30 (COP30, DSM, TanDEM-X) via OpenTopography: existing data/raw/earth_cop30/cop30_gate2_area.tif for candidates; new OpenTopography COP30 requests for target groups. Reprojected bilinear to site-centred aeqd 30 m grid (src/gate3_common.earth_patch).
data.scoring_2m: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (bare-earth DTM, lidar) read from USGS S3, area-averaged to 2 m in UTM 11N (EPSG:26911).
data.pairing_note: COP30 is a surface model (DSM) from TanDEM-X; 3DEP is a lidar bare-earth DTM. Different sensors are not independent validation; desert sites expected to have sparse vegetation (not verified per pixel).

methods.A: Full fingerprint A at 30 m: 19 frozen features (scales 30,60,120,240,480 m), z-scored with the Gate 3 pooled mean/std (recomputed deterministically from data/processed/gate3_patches_30m.npz, same as results/gap_map.json run). Target covered by a site if d < T, T = 2.317 (threshold_T in results/gap_map.json, 2.3166). Greedy per group: each pick maximises number of still-uncovered targets with d < T; any zero-gain step stops (including the first: then A recommends no site and this is reported as 'no coverage meeting the threshold'). Tie-break: lower mean distance to uncovered targets, then site ID. Max 3 sites.
methods.B: Slope baseline: per-pixel slope on the 30 m grid; site provides a bin if >= 5% of its valid 30 m area is in it. Greedy: each pick maximises newly covered target valid 30 m area (targets' 30 m bins); stop at zero gain (including first). Tie-break: site ID. Max 3 sites.
methods.C: Random reference: per group, 200 random combinations of 3 distinct eligible sites, numpy default_rng(20261114 + group_index).

scoring.after: recommendations frozen and written to disk before any target 2 m data is read for scoring
scoring.provides: site provides a bin if >= 5% of its valid 2 m area is in it
scoring.coverage: metre-scale slope-condition coverage = share of the 3 targets' pooled valid 2 m area whose bin is provided by >= 1 selected site; 0 if no site selected
scoring.slope_2m: per-pixel slope (deg) on the 2 m grid by central differences

classification: Step 1 INCONCLUSIVE checks first (fewer than 8 qualifying groups; retrospective only; data/pairing not qualified; method not executed as registered; timeout/incomplete; formal ceiling >= 7/8 groups with random median >= 95%). Step 2 in order: PASS_FULL (A beats B in >= 7/8 groups; median paired A-B >= +10 points; no group A worse than B by > 10 points; A > random p95 in >= 7/8 groups) else BASELINE_ONLY (B > random p95 in >= 7/8 groups) else NO_SUPPORT. Prototype acceptance criteria, not NASA engineering standards.
known_bias: The scoring metric is slope-condition coverage, which structurally favours B. If A loses, the only allowed statement is: 'On this slope-condition coverage task, the full fingerprint showed no benefit over the simple slope method.'
sample_nature: new spatial holdout (targets outside the Gate 2 box), same regional climate/geology (Mojave/SE California); not external validation
precheck: results/g3v_precheck_rule.json -> results/g3v_precheck_results.json: 5/8 pseudo-groups random median >= 95% (no stop)
